class.name: DSTex
class.brief_description: Reads and writes the DirectStorage compressed texture format.
class.description: [DSTex] creates and inspects [code].dstex[/code] files. The container format supports version 1 and version 2 textures. Version 2 stores D3D12-aligned mip offsets (512-byte alignment) and 24-byte per-mip footprint metadata ([code]DSTexMipEntryV2[/code] with 256-byte pitch-aligned uncompressed sizes and row pitches), enabling direct GPU GDeflate decompression to VRAM. The resource loader can load [code].dstex[/code] files as [Texture2D] or [Texture2DRD] resources automatically.

method.name: get_file_info
method.description: Returns the same header and mip metadata dictionary as [method read_header].

method.name: godot_format_to_rd_format
method.description: Converts an [Image] format value to the corresponding [RenderingDevice] data format value. If [param is_srgb] is [code]true[/code], returns the corresponding sRGB format variant when supported.

method.name: read_from_file
method.description: Reads a complete [code].dstex[/code] file. The result contains [code]header[/code] ([Dictionary]), [code]compressed_data[/code] ([PackedByteArray]), [code]mip_offsets[/code] ([PackedInt64Array]), [code]mip_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), and [code]mip_row_pitches[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]). For version 2 files, it also includes [code]mip_data[/code] ([Array] of [PackedByteArray] containing per-mip payloads). Returns an empty dictionary when the file is invalid or cannot be opened.

method.name: read_header
method.description: Reads the [code].dstex[/code] header and mip table. The result contains [code]magic[/code] ([int]), [code]version[/code] ([int]), [code]flags[/code] ([int]), [code]width[/code] ([int]), [code]height[/code] ([int]), [code]pixel_format[/code] ([int]), [code]mip_count[/code] ([int]), [code]original_size[/code] ([int]), [code]compressed_size[/code] ([int]), [code]reserved[/code] ([int]), [code]mip_offsets[/code] ([PackedInt64Array]), [code]mip_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), and [code]mip_row_pitches[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]).

method.name: rd_format_to_godot_format
method.description: Converts a [RenderingDevice] data format value to the corresponding [Image] format value.

method.name: write_to_file
method.description: Compresses [param raw_data] with GDeflate and writes a version 2 [code].dstex[/code] file. Calculates D3D12 footprint metadata (256-byte aligned row pitch and 512-byte aligned mip data placements) for hardware GPU decompression. [param format] is an [Image] format value. If [param is_srgb] is [code]true[/code], sets the sRGB format flag in the header and encodes the format as sRGB. Returns [constant OK] on success or a Godot [Error] code on invalid data, compression failure, or file access failure.
